recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, studio-lit group portrait of three musicians arranged in a triangular formation, featuring a central female figure flanked by two males. The image is characterized by a warm, golden atmospheric glow emanating from the bottom and top edges, framed by a thin white border.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular subject arrangement with the central figure slightly forward
Warm golden light flares contrasting with a neutral olive-grey background
Bold white typography anchored in the lower-left quadrant
Thin white geometric frame containing the entire composition
coreInvariants: Thin white border inset from the edges
Warm golden gradient overlays at the top and bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a medium shot, waist-up; central figure is the primary focus, with side figures slightly recessed.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure's face and the bold white text block in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move to the flanking figures, then drop to the high-contrast text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the subjects fill the majority of the frame, with small gaps around the heads against the flat background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral olive-grey background providing a muted base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and browns in clothing and hair to ground the subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow light flares and text accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the light flares; medium saturation in the gold tones; low saturation in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and metallic golds

composition.relationshipToImage: anchored to the bottom-left corner within the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and color to establish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, modern, and authoritative feel of the primary text.
Provides a similar geometric structure and clean terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three people (one female center, two males flanking) against a muted olive-grey background. Apply a soft golden light flare at the top center and a stronger golden gradient at the bottom. Add a thin white border inset slightly from the image edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the lower-left corner. Directly beneath it, place a second line of text in the same font but smaller and in a golden-yellow color.

verificationChecks: Is the text left-aligned in the lower-left quadrant?
Is there a thin white border around the entire composition?
Are the golden light flares present at the top and bottom?
Is the central figure the most prominent in the trio?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the golden light flares
Specific shade of the olive-grey background
mustRedesign: Specific jewelry or clothing patterns that are proprietary
postGenerationChecks: Check for color harmony between the golden flares and the subtitle text.
Ensure the white border is perfectly symmetrical.
Verify the text does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Confirm the background is a flat, neutral studio tone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Trio Portrait + Golden Light Flares + Geometric Sans-Serif Typography + Thin White Frame
